mechanism: Small 5 kg batches roasted Thursday and delivered Friday in Minsk.
scene: A Minsk customer opens an ad on a phone while thinking about coffee at home or in the office.
excludedDefaults: Brown kraft-bag split hero with cream background and serif headline

candidates.name: Neighborhood noticeboard
candidates.why: An approachable local voice and immediately scannable offers fit visitors ordering from a nearby workshop.
candidates.world: Bottle-green board, off-white notices, restrained melon ink, sturdy Cyrillic grotesque; the order slip is functional.

candidates.name: Friday route
candidates.why: A simple Thursday-to-Friday sequence explains freshness without inventing delivery routes.
candidates.world: Bright white, bus blue and leaf green; humanist wayfinding type, continuous schedule line, explicit stops.

candidates.name: Kitchen cloth
candidates.why: A familiar home surface connects fresh beans with an everyday ritual.
candidates.world: Butter yellow woven ground, cobalt checks, ink-blue Cyrillic sans; one textile grid carries quiet copy and ordering.

candidates.name: Coffee shelf index
candidates.why: Different origins and tasting notes become easy to compare through a small orderly catalog.
candidates.world: Lilac dividers, deep plum ink, numbered shelf labels, practical book-jacket grotesque; origin tabs select real products.

candidates.name: Friday edition
candidates.why: The actual weekly roasting and delivery cadence becomes the organizing structure for a recurring coffee edition.
candidates.world: Sunflower-yellow fields, indigo ink, cool pale paper, wide sturdy Cyrillic grotesque; weekly cadence owns the first screen, not a badge.

candidates.name: Workshop door
candidates.family: Enamel address signs and apartment directories
candidates.why: The actual workshop address makes the roastery feel like a specific local place.
candidates.world: Milk-white enamel, petrol blue lettering, small coral wayfinding; address-scale lettering and clearly separated request fields.

candidates.name: Friday market
candidates.family: Produce stalls and reusable wooden crates
candidates.why: Weekly deliveries and an honest small assortment resonate with neighborhood shopping habits.
candidates.world: Pale wood, tomato red painted identifiers, deep blue text; slatted rhythm organizes real packs and prices.
